editorial:
Imagine you are dropped into a wild ride through Italy where everything feels bright but dangerous. You follow a woman who is terrified that her sister has been snatched by a creepy killer. She teams up with Inspector Enzo Avolfi, a cop who realizes they are dealing with someone truly twisted. The whole movie feels like a colorful nightmare. It is not your typical slow mystery; it is a fast-paced chase that keeps you on edge as you try to figure out who this killer, known as Yellow, actually is.

What really pops are the bright colors and the shocking violence. The plot has some weird twists that might leave you scratching your head, but that is part of the fun. The acting is okay, though the story is the real star here. If you like movies that feel like a comic book brought to life with a dark twist, you will love this. To get the best experience, you should stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video to see all those vivid colors. If you are a collector, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is a great move for the best picture quality.
endingExplained: You find out that the killer is actually a woman who was driven mad by a past trauma. She wanted to punish people she felt were wrong. In the final showdown, the inspector and the main character track her down to a hideout. After a scary fight, the killer is finally stopped. It turns out the whole mystery was tied to a series of clues left behind that pointed to her all along.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves flashy slashers and twisty mysteries.
